paragraphs.text: Gobakhan is a desert plane with twin suns, where civilization is surrounded by two massive sandstorms known as the Eastern Cloud and the Western Cloud. These contain deadly amounts of diamond micrograins.

The people of Gobakhan depend on the monks of the Order of the Shieldmage to protect them against the diamond storms. The planeswalker Teyo Verada used to be an acolyte of that order. Much of the landscape of Gobakhan consists of dunes of sand. One of the bigger settlements on Gobakhan is the town of Oasis .
The Eastern Cloud - a front of perpetual sandstorms containing tiny grains of diamond. Source of air-djinni.
Monastery of the Order of the Shieldmage - all external surfaces of the buildings are reinforced with diamonds. Garden of the Order - a small garden in the monastery's courtyard.

Oasis - for Gobakhan, Oasis is a big town, yet the whole town could have fit comfortably within the Tenth District Plaza on Ravnica . Oasis has a small park in the town square, and a single inn, which is equipped with an actual lavatory with plumbing, a rarity.
The Western Cloud - a wall of perpetual diamond storms, riddled with heat lightning. Source of fire-djinni.
Beasts Carry-beasts - domesticated animals used for transport.

Gobakhan was a target in the New Phyrexian Invasion . The Order of the Shieldmage was the primary force that protected the plane. The plane's diamond storms hampered Phyrexia’s progress until they compleated some of the local shieldmages.
